title: Normalized monoidal descent to a pro-etale object
statement: Given arbitrary pro-etale coefficient comparison data [def-zl-proetale-slice-comparison-data] and an ordinary inverse-image/restriction isomorphism with its distinguished-section normalization, there exist exact restriction and scalar-transport tensor descents, ordinary unit isomorphisms and their pure-generator and localization equations. Their ordinary isomorphism is the given one. The canonical derived pullback tensor comparison respects the specified Koszul symmetries. This is the monoidal part only, without any internal-Hom assertion.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 08J9, 08JB and 0FPT; normalized slice comparison in Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach Lemma 4.5.

proof.text: Use the supplied ordinary comparison and its section normalization. Identify the source small site with the literal slice via the canonical equivalence. The section equation fixes the ordinary map used in each tensor compatibility calculation.

Restrict the ordinary tensor comparison to the small site of U. Scalar transport is an exact equivalence with the same pure-tensor maps in both directions. The restriction unit is identity; the scalar unit is b. Extend these maps to signed total complexes and localize on K-flat representatives; the representative models determine the natural comparisons and exact squares.

For the pullback tensor square both paths send (x tensor s) tensor (y tensor t) to b inverse(st) times (delta(x) tensor delta(y)). For units they agree by b delta_O=c. Equality on sheafified generators and the K-flat localization characterization identify them with the specified canonical comparisons. On bidegree (p,q) both symmetry routes send x tensor y to (-1)^(pq)y tensor x. The given coherence witnesses and localization extend the equality to all derived objects.

theorem proEtaleSlice_monoidal_descent {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.ProEt)
    (O : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (B : Sheaf (ProEt.topology U.left) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage U.hom CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj O ≅ B)
    (delta : ProEtaleObjectRestrictionComparison U CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure (proEtaleCoefficientHom X O))
    (SR : CoefficientClosedStructure (proEtaleCoefficientHom U.left (proEtaleSliceRing U O)))
    (SB : CoefficientClosedStructure (proEtaleCoefficientHom U.left B))
    (T : CoefficientTensorModels.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology X) O S)
    (TR : CoefficientTensorModels.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology U.left)
      (proEtaleSliceRing U O) SR)
    (TB : CoefficientTensorModels.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology U.left) B SB)
    (beta : @SymmetricCategory (DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X O)) _ S.monoidal)
    (betaB : @SymmetricCategory (DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules U.left B)) _ SB.monoidal)
    (_coherence : RingedDerivedTensorCoherence.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (ProEt.topology X) O S T beta)
    (_coherenceB : RingedDerivedTensorCoherence.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (ProEt.topology U.left) B SB TB betaB)
    (i : proEtaleRingModulePullback U.hom O B c ≅
      proEtaleSliceModuleRestriction U O ⋙
        ProEtaleCoefficientSliceComparison.e U O B c delta)
    (hi : ∀ (N : proEtaleRingModules X O) (V : U.left.ProEt)
      (m : N.val.obj
        (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map (f := U.hom) ⊤ U.prop).obj V))),
      (i.hom.app N).val.app (op V)
        (proEtaleSlicePullbackSection U O B c N V m) = m) :
    ∃ d : ProEtaleCoefficientSliceComparison.TensorData U O B c delta S SR SB T TR TB,
      d.ordinary = i ∧
      ProEtaleCoefficientSliceComparison.TensorNormalized U O B c delta S SR SB T TR TB d ∧
      ∀ L M : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X O),
        (proEtaleRingDerivedPullback U.hom O B c).map
            (beta.toBraidedCategory.braiding L M).hom ≫
            (ProEtaleCoefficientSliceComparison.rho U O B c S SB T TB).hom.app (M, L) =
          (ProEtaleCoefficientSliceComparison.rho U O B c S SB T TB).hom.app (L, M) ≫
            (betaB.toBraidedCategory.braiding
              ((proEtaleRingDerivedPullback U.hom O B c).obj L)
              ((proEtaleRingDerivedPullback U.hom O B c).obj M)).hom
